subject: general
question: A hemispherical bowl is made of thick steel having thickness 0.5 cm. If the external diameter of the bowl is 43 cm, then the capacity of the bowl is: (Use π = (22)/(7))
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Identify **Internal radius (r)** = (External diameter ÷ 2) − Thickness

r = (43 ÷ 2) − 0.5 = 21.5 − 0.5 = **21 cm**

**Capacity** = &frac{2}{3} × π × r³ = &frac{2}{3} × &frac{22}{7} × 21 × 21 × 21

Capacity = 44 × 21 × 21 = 44 × 441 = **19404 cm³**

**∴ The correct answer is 19404 cm³.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**External diameter (D)** = 43 cm

**Thickness (t)** = 0.5 cm

**π** = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

**Internal radius (r)** = (External diameter/2) − Thickness

**Capacity (V)** = Volume of hemisphere = &frac{2}{3} × π × r³

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2da47b1f5a0478dbc03f2e120ff7a72c6c86742028a89732f9a67e87f9225cb6.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ External Radius (R) = 43 ÷ 2 = 21.5 cm

⇒ Internal Radius (r) = 21.5 − 0.5 = 21 cm

⇒ Capacity = &frac{2}{3} × &frac{22}{7} × (21)³

⇒ Capacity = &frac{2}{3} × &frac{22}{7} × 21 × 21 × 21

⇒ Capacity = 2 × 22 × 3 × 21 × 21 ÷ 3

⇒ Capacity = 44 × 441

⇒ Capacity = 19404 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 19404 cm³.**

**__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Sphere

The volume of a complete sphere is given by V = &frac{4}{3} π r³.

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of Hemisphere

The area of the curved part of a hemisphere is CSA = 2 π r².

Total Surface Area (TSA) of Hemisphere

Including the flat circular base, the total surface area is TSA = 3 π r².

Volume of Material used in Hollow Hemisphere

The volume of the material (like steel) is &frac{2}{3} π (R³ − r³), where R is outer and r is inner radius.</p
